rationale: The workflow runs a matrix of Ruby and ActiveRecord versions nightly, performing a full `bundle install` each time. Evidence from a measured experiment (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2) on a similar Ruby matrix workflow shows that adding an explicit Bundler dependency cache (actions/cache) for `vendor/bundle` yields ~10.5% elapsed time savings. The pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE also supports caching dependency downloads when repeated fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile and environment. This workflow meets those preconditions: it uses distinct gemfiles per matrix combination (gemfiles/${{ matrix.ar }}.gemfile) and runs daily. The change adds a cache step keyed by OS, Ruby version, ActiveRecord version, and the gemfile hash, with fallback restore keys. It also sets BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle so that `bundle install` uses the cached directory. No other behavior is altered; test coverage and required checks are preserved.
